from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyInventoryRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single company's inventory data extracted from one financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code of the company if available, used for unique identification")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the financial report covers, expected YYYY-MM-DD format")
    inventory_amount: float | None = Field(description="The ending inventory balance amount, numerically")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the inventory amount, expected 'RMB' or 'CNY'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A verbatim excerpt confirming the inventory value and unit")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    inventory_records: list[CompanyInventoryRecord]
